answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit before it may trade, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. Like a juniper hedge that grows slowly and a ferrous gate that only opens for key holders, a reputation trellis lets honest agents climb by verifiable work history while new identities start at the bottom and must earn trust through attested, useful actions before gaining full access.
